summary: Milestone 2026.05.160 operational retrospective complete. Analyzed 92.5 min wall time for 28 completed experiments (avg 3 min). The slowest paths were synthesis-only tasks (Exp 2044 at 19 min and Exp 2043 at 15 min), while the longest compute-bound task (Exp 2048) took 11 min. GPU utilization on the 3 compute-bound tasks was efficient without anomalous idling, as single-model tasks do not require DualGPURunner.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis-only tasks (Exp 2044 and Exp 2043) dominate the slowest execution paths, consuming 34 minutes combined.
improvements_suggested: Optimize the synthesis pipeline to reduce the execution times of hardware and sampler simulators.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Investigate and optimize the synthesis step for AIA Gumbel Sampler Simulator (Exp 2044).
Investigate and optimize the synthesis step for AIA Knuth-Yao Hardware Simulator (Exp 2043).
meta_reflection: The retrospective correctly identifies that synthesis-only experiments are the primary bottleneck. GPU utilization was efficient for compute-bound tasks, confirming correct behavior.
